facts.text: The Bison Pact covers the gap between Oklahoma's Promise and the full cost of tuition and general fees for qualifying students.

sources.title: OBU's New Bison Pact: Transforming Higher Education Accessibility ...
sources.quote: The Bison Pact covers the gap between Oklahoma's Promise and the cost of tuition and general fees providing students with a significant financial boost toward the cost of their education.
